game.title: New Orleans Saints at Baltimore Ravens

lede: Baltimore Ravens carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play), while New Orleans Saints owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#10 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Baltimore Ravens -5.4 with a fair total of 44.9 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New Orleans Saints run offence vs Baltimore Ravens run defence, which sits −0.166 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
